title: Forensic log‑forwarder Terraform module: cross-account CloudTrail -> S3 + OpenSearch ILM + cold archive
creator: Maya Rodriguez
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) customers require a reproducible Terraform module to route CloudTrail and platform audit events into a cost-efficient, queryable stack while meeting compliance retention. Current repo has ad-hoc scripts and duplicated tfmodules across customers.

Goal: Deliver a single opinionated, reusable Terraform module that: 1) provisions cross-account CloudTrail -> S3 delivery with per-tenant partitioned buckets and KMS encryption; 2) configures an OpenSearch sink (log-shipper) with index naming conventions and ILM policies (hot-warm-cold-delete) and periodic snapshots to a separate S3 archive; 3) implements lifecycle policies to move raw events to Glacier/Deep Archive after X days; 4) includes operational health checks, dashboards, and an upgrade/migration path for index mappings and ILM changes.
acceptance_criteria:
- Terraform module exists at terraform/modules/forensic-log-forwarder and exposes documented variables for account ids, environments, bucket prefixes, KMS key ARNs, and OpenSearch domain info.
- Cross-account roles and bucket policies are generated with least privilege for CloudTrail and shipper EC2/Lambda.
- S3 lifecycle rules include transition to Glacier Deep Archive after configurable retention (default 365 days) and non-destructive delete guardrails (optional legal_hold flag).
- OpenSearch ILM policy created with hot-warm-cold phases, snapshot policy exporting snapshots to S3, and an automated roll-over alias.
- Module ships integration tests (localstack-based + staging AWS) and a smoke Terraform plan that applies in a test account.
- Health checks: CloudWatch metrics and alarms (s3:ObjectCount lag, OpenSearch index age, failed snapshot count) deployed and wired into existing PagerDuty channel.
- Audit manual: Confluence doc with runbook for index migration and emergency restore steps is linked from module README.
notes:
Design decisions made in initial spike: use per-tenant prefixes in a shared S3 delegated bucket to reduce bucket count; make Glacier Deep Archive optional via variable to avoid unexpected cost for early-stage customers. Chosen shipper pattern: an opinionated Lambda-based bulk uploader to OpenSearch (v1.x) that also writes manifest files for traceability.

Trade-offs: shared bucket reduces management but increases blast radius for bucket-level misconfiguration; we mitigate with strict IAM + bucket ownership enforcement and automated Terraform validations. OpenSearch ILM snapshots add S3 cost but allow index-level restores for forensic investigations.

Future: evaluate replacing shipper with vector/FluentD if we need richer parsing or non-JSON transforms.
implementation_steps:
1) Module scaffolding and variable/outputs schema.
2) Cross-account IAM roles and CloudTrail resource with S3 target.
3) S3 bucket provisioning with per-tenant prefixes, KMS encryption, lifecycle rules, and bucket policies.
4) Shipper infra: Lambda + execution role + security group (VPC-enabled) or ECS task option.
5) OpenSearch index template + ILM policy + snapshot repository + IAM.
6) Smoke/integration tests (localstack, staging).
7) Observability: CloudWatch metrics, Dashboard, PagerDuty alerts.
8) Docs + migration runbook + CHANGELOG and upgrade notes.
9) Security review and rolling deployment to 2 pilot customers.
10) Post-deploy retro and iterate on defaults.
updates:
2026-02-12: Spike complete — validated cross-account CloudTrail delivery to a delegated S3 bucket. Prototype code in branch feature/forensic-forwarder-spike. Findings: need explicit s3:PutObjectAcl avoidance; fixed via PutObject with bucket-owner-full-control.
2026-02-20: Module scaffold PR opened (GH: redwood-infra/terraform#482). Initial variables and role templates added. Seeking review from infra-security for KMS key policy.
2026-02-27: Security review feedback: require explicit kms:Encrypt/decrypt conditions, add condition restricting role assumption from only known account IDs; asked to add optional legal_hold variable for regulatory customers. Action: updated IAM trust policy and added legal_hold toggle.
2026-03-03: Integration test harness added using localstack; tests green for S3 delivery and lifecycle unit. OpenSearch snapshots are failing in localstack — flagged as known limitation, added staging test step that runs nightly on a small staging account.
2026-03-08: Design review with Platform PM (Anika Singh) and Observability (Jae Kim). Agreed default retention 365 days for raw S3, 90 days hot ILM, 180 warm. Decision to expose defaults but allow per-customer override. Planning pilot rollout for two customers in Cycle 41.
2026-03-10: PR updated with improved README, example usage for VPC + non-VPC deployments, and migration notes. Ready for final approval—waiting on one last sign-off from Security (ticket: SEC-1213).
migration_plan:
Phase 1: Create new per-tenant prefixes and shipper; write a backfill manifest that replays historical CloudTrail for last 90 days into OpenSearch (offline job).
Phase 2: Create ILM and snapshot policy on new indices then cut alias from old indices to new alias (blue-green style).
Phase 3: After 90 days of parity, apply lifecycle to old indices and schedule deletion per retention.
Rollback: snapshot restore from S3 archive to a new index and swap alias. Runbook steps documented in Confluence.
tests: Unit tests for Terraform variable validation (tfsec + checkov), integration tests using localstack for S3 + CloudTrail delivery signatures, nightly staging run for OpenSearch snapshots. Add acceptance gate in CI to prevent accidental delete of production buckets (manual approval).
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Misconfigured bucket policy could leak logs across tenants. Mitigation: automated Terraform policy linter + pre-apply plan checks that enforce owner_id and bucket prefix constraints.
Risk: OpenSearch snapshot failures causing inability to restore. Mitigation: alerting + daily snapshot verification job and automated snapshot validation report.
Risk: Unexpected cost from Glacier Deep Archive for large accounts. Mitigation: default to 365d, provide cost-estimate script and customer opt-in for <90d archive.
